page_title: CRY 1-1 BHA | Crystal Palace v Brighton 21/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' John Brooks is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+4' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
90+4' Great teamplay by Crystal Palace as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' That's a clear yellow card. Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) goes into the book.

90' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to pounce on the rebound. His effort misses the right post by a whisker! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
87' Jakub Moder (Brighton) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
85' David Ozoh (Crystal Palace) has tested the patience of referee John Brooks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
83' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Kaoru Mitoma and he is replaced by Jakub Moder (Brighton).

82' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) alters the score to 1:1. He finds himself some space near the penalty spot to connect with a brilliant cross from Pascal Gross and plants a header towards the top right corner, glancing in off the post. Dean Henderson was helpless. Excellent finish!
81' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
80' Crystal Palace have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
75' Substitution. Jack Hinshelwood did his best and is replaced by Adam Lallana (Brighton).
73' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) tries to find Pascal Gross, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
70' Roy Hodgson decides to make a substitution. Jordan Ayew will be replaced by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace).
69' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

67' A precise short pass from Pascal Gross releases Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
65' Dean Henderson stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Billy Gilmour (Brighton) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the bottom right corner.
64' Brighton are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
63' 38:62 – the latest ball possession ratio.
59' The manager makes a subsitution with David Ozoh (Crystal Palace) coming on for Will Hughes.

59' Dean Henderson makes a brilliant save! Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
59' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) takes the free kick which is inaccurate and the defence has no problem with the clearance.
57' What was Igor (Brighton) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
57' Igor (Brighton) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Crystal Palace will take a free kick near the side line.
57' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
56' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Brighton for a penalty. Play continues.
55' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) latches onto the free kick from Pascal Gross, but heads just wide of the right post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
54' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.

52' Joao Pedro (Brighton) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
51' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Pascal Gross (Brighton). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

50' Pascal Gross (Brighton) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Brighton can continue in their attacking effort.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
47' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Crystal Palace.
46' Roberto De Zerbi makes a switch. Danny Welbeck is coming on in place of Simon Adingra (Brighton) at the start of the second period.
46' Half-time substitution. Carlos Baleba (Brighton) will not participate anymore and Facundo Buonanotte is coming on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' John Brooks blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' 1 - 0 Goal! Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) makes the score 1:0 after burying a close-range header in the bottom left corner after a good run and cross by Michael Olise.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Pascal Gross (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but Dean Henderson comes off his line to gather the ball.
40' Pascal Gross (Brighton) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the top left corner and forces a good save out of Dean Henderson.
40' Wonderful pass from Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) for Jean-Philippe Mateta, but they can't profit from it as Bart Verbruggen comes off his line to collect.
39' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Simon Adingra (Brighton).
36' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
36' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
36' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
34' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
33' Bart Verbruggen leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Michael Olise (Crystal Palace).

33' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) sends a cross in and finds Jean-Philippe Mateta inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
33' The resulting set piece from Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) is successfully intercepted by the defender.
31' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
31' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) makes a slide tackle, but referee John Brooks blows for a foul. Crystal Palace earn a free kick.
29' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
27' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Bart Verbruggen was alert and made a comfortable save.
25' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) passes the ball onto Jean-Philippe Mateta, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
25' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee John Brooks signals. Crystal Palace win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
23' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

19' Simon Adingra (Brighton) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Dean Henderson, who tips the ball around the post. Carlos Baleba (Brighton) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
17' Pascal Gross nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
13' Good defending. Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) tries to find Jean-Philippe Mateta inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
11' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts the ball.
10' The Crystal Palace players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
7' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is flagged for offside.

4' Pascal Gross (Brighton) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
2' Brighton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half has started.
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
John Brooks got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
